title: rotki/action-job-checker config
description: Configuration for the rotki/action-job-checker GitHub Action. Declares the job groups that should be evaluated against PR changes.

groups.description: Job groups evaluated by the action. Each group produces a `<name>_tasks` output.

name.description: Unique group identifier. Must start with a lowercase letter; only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores allowed. Becomes the output name as `<name>_tasks`.

paths.description: Paths whose changes turn this group on. A path matches when a changed file equals it or starts with it followed by `/`. Leave empty for groups that should only be triggered by `run_tag` or `implies`.

run_tag.description: Commit-message tag (without brackets) that forces this group on, e.g. `run backend` matches `[run backend]`. When any group's run_tag fires, path-based detection is skipped.

skip_tag.description: Commit-message tag (without brackets) that forces this group off after detection, e.g. `skip py tests`.

implies.description: Other group names that should also be turned on whenever this group is.

environments.description: Optional commit-message tags that set the `<name>_environment` output to a value when this group is going to run.
